answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1781 Country: United States of America Title: I would like to know if working in a store that sell clothes, food, candies, wine, milk etc. be halaal earning if you are working as a cashier? What if the store doesn't sell wine but has other haraam things like haraam candy and magazines will the earning be halaal? Question: I would like to know if working in a store that sell clothes, food, candies, wine, milk etc. be halaal earning if you are working as a cashier? What if the store doesn't sell wine but has other haraam things like haraam candy and magazines will the earning be halaal? Answer ID: 1781 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1109/1029=B) A Muslim is neither allowed to work in such a store nor is his earning allowed. He should look for a job in any store dealing in halal items. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
